45 Years of You

Today is about celebrating you, Mum. Not just the years you’ve lived, but the love you’ve given, the strength you’ve shown and the lives you’ve touched.

I know life hasn’t always been easy, but through every season, you’ve continued to show up. I hope this new chapter brings you the happiness, peace and beautiful moments you deserve.

A Letter From Your Son

Dear Mum,

Sometimes I wish I could put everything I feel into words, but I don’t think words will ever be enough.

You’ve been there for me through so many different stages of my life. Even when things weren’t easy for you, you still found a way to be there for me.

Since Dad passed away, you’ve continued to stand by me. I know it hasn’t been easy, and there are probably so many things you’ve had to deal with that I don’t even fully understand.

But I see you, Mum. I see your strength, your sacrifices and the way you’ve continued to support me.

I’ve made mistakes, I’ve had my own difficult moments, but you’ve never stopped being my mother. You’ve continued to understand me, support me and believe in me.

There are so many things I’m learning from you, some of which you might not even realise.

I want you to live a long and beautiful life. I want you to be here to witness my success, enjoy the things I’m working towards and experience the happiness you deserve.

This year, I passed all my modules again, with two distinctions. I hope that makes you proud. I’m still learning, still growing and still working towards the future I dream of.

And when I finally get there, I want you to enjoy it with me. I want to share my happiness with you because you deserve to experience the beautiful things life has to offer.

Please take care of yourself and stay strong. I still have so much I want to show you.

I’m excited for this new chapter of your life. May 45 bring you more happiness, good health, peace and countless reasons to smile.

Happy birthday, Mum.

I love you more than you’ll ever know.

With love,
Your son ❤️
